ApiGatewayResponseExtensions.cs.reason: Error mapper converting EncinaError to ApiGatewayResponse; unit tests cover all code paths, guard tests cover null-parameter checks

justifications.unit: Every error code and HTTP status mapping, including each encina.authorization.* code, has a unit test.
justifications.guard: Guard tests pass null, default (bottom-state) and boundary arguments to every public method and convert each error-code family, so every line runs; the margin covers future branches.
justifications.integration: Integration tests convert the results of a real Encina pipeline (success, validation, conflict, missing handler and each error family) to REST, HTTP API v2, created and no-content responses and read the wire JSON back, so every line runs.

EncinaAwsLambdaOptions.cs.reason: Configuration POCO with defaults and validation

justifications.unit: Every option property is read and set in tests, including its defaults.
justifications.guard: Guard tests instantiate the options and set the correlation-id, tenant-trust and user-id properties while exercising the context extensions and the health check; one property initializer is never read by a guard test.
justifications.integration: Integration tests configure the options through AddEncinaAwsLambda and the handlers and health check read them; one property initializer is never read by these tests.

justifications.guard: Guard tests pass null events, null detail, malformed or null raw JSON and throwing delegates to every public method, so every line runs.
justifications.integration: Integration tests process EventBridge events deserialized by the Lambda serializer through a real handler, covering success, error, null detail, a throwing delegate, raw JSON and metadata.

Health/AwsLambdaHealthCheck.cs.reason: Health check with mockeable service dependencies

justifications.guard: Guard tests construct the health check with valid and null-valued options and read its result; the in-Lambda branch needs the process-global AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME variable, which parallel tests must not change.
justifications.integration: Integration tests resolve the health check from a validated provider and read its status and data outside Lambda; the in-Lambda branch needs the process-global AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME variable, which parallel tests must not change.

justifications.unit: Every ResolveTenantId rule is unit-tested, with the logger asserted through a fake.
justifications.guard: Guard tests pass null contexts, null or empty headers, empty, non-string and mismatching tenant claims and absent authorizer entries, so nearly every line runs; the successful JSON-element user-id claim path is left to the unit flag (#3075).
justifications.integration: Integration tests resolve correlation, tenant and user ids from API Gateway requests deserialized by the Lambda serializer; the remaining lines are the absent-claim-property branch, string-valued authorizer entries and the plain string claim and principalId paths of GetUserId, left to the unit flag.

justifications.unit: Source-generated [LoggerMessage] partials are not measured as hand-written lines; the events are asserted via a fake logger in LambdaResolveTenantIdTests.
justifications.guard: Source-generated [LoggerMessage] partials have no parameters to guard.
justifications.integration: Source-generated [LoggerMessage] partials are not measured as hand-written lines; the events are exercised through the fake loggers of the integration tests.

justifications.guard: Guard tests pass a null collection and a null configure delegate to both overloads and register through both overloads, once and twice, with a validated provider, so every line runs; the margin covers future branches.
justifications.integration: Integration tests build providers with ValidateOnBuild and ValidateScopes through both AddEncinaAwsLambda overloads and resolve the options and the health check.

justifications.guard: Guard tests pass null events and processors, null records, empty and malformed bodies, throwing delegates and cancelled tokens to every public method; the one unreached line is the unreachable Right branch inside ProcessAllAsync.
justifications.integration: Integration tests process SQS events deserialized by the Lambda serializer with a real handler, covering partial batch failures, malformed bodies, a throwing delegate, cancellation, ProcessAllAsync and DeserializeMessage; the one unreached line is the unreachable Right branch inside ProcessAllAsync.
